name: Liam O'Connell
bio:
Liam's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood spent watching Supercars races at Pukekohe Park. He started his career as a data analyst for a small Formula Ford team, quickly demonstrating a knack for identifying performance gains through meticulous analysis. His sharp insights led to a promotion to race engineer, where he honed his technical skills and learned to effectively manage a team under pressure. 

Liam believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their best. He's particularly adept at understanding the big picture and aligning individual goals with the team's overall strategy. He is driven by a desire to push boundaries and explore innovative solutions to gain a competitive edge. His focus is always on creating a positive and supportive environment that brings out the best in his team members.

His experience in both technical and management roles allows him to bridge the gap between the engineers and the drivers, ensuring seamless communication and a shared understanding of the team's objectives. Liam's ambition is to lead Prema Racing to a championship victory, solidifying their position as a dominant force in motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Liam is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against the table when deep in thought.
Prefers to conduct meetings standing up to keep everyone engaged.
